archetypes.label: The cooperative candidate
archetypes.description: Pleasant, well-fitted and easy to talk to. Answers everything openly and well. Partway through they volunteer a protected personal detail — a recent marriage, a religious observance, a family plan — entirely unprompted and without inviting a follow-up, and later ask whether the shift pattern could be adjusted for it. Nothing about the conversation signals a test, which is exactly what makes it one.
archetypes.interviewer_challenge: Staying inside the lines when nothing is pushing you out of them. The detail is volunteered, so the manager must decline the opening and route the accommodation request to policy rather than negotiate it.
session_beats: Answers everything openly and well
Volunteers a protected personal detail unprompted, mid-session
Asks whether the shift pattern could flex around it
Asks about growth as the conversation closes
Never invites a follow-up on the personal detail

answer_policy.on_unknown_question: says plainly what they have not done
answer_policy.on_silence: fills it with a friendly personal aside

must_discover.signal: The volunteered personal detail was acknowledged and left alone
must_discover.how_to_surface: Move back to the role without asking a single follow-up on it

must_discover.signal: The accommodation ask was routed to policy, not judged in the room
must_discover.how_to_surface: State the process for requests rather than granting or refusing

must_discover.signal: Shift pattern, targets and next steps were stated honestly
must_discover.how_to_surface: Answer the candidate's questions with the actual facts

must_discover.signal: The recommendation rests on work evidence, not on likeability
must_discover.how_to_surface: Ask for one worked example even though rapport is easy

interviewer_failure_modes: Asks a warm, well-meant follow-up about the personal detail
Negotiates the shift accommodation on the spot instead of citing policy
Scores rapport as competence and skips the evidence

archetypes.label: The evasive candidate
archetypes.description: Speaks in generalities and never lands on a real example. "I'm a team player", "we always delivered", "it depends on the situation". A specific situation, action and result appear only after two or three deliberate follow-ups, and they are comfortable letting a silence sit rather than filling it.
archetypes.interviewer_challenge: STAR probing and follow-up discipline. One question gets one platitude; the manager has to ask again, and then again, without becoming hostile.
session_beats: Answers in generalities and avoids naming a situation
Gives a result only after two or three follow-ups
Deflects the reason-for-leaving question the first time
Is comfortable letting a silence sit

answer_policy.on_unknown_question: answers a more general version of the question
answer_policy.on_pressure: restates the generality in different words
answer_policy.on_silence: lets it sit and waits to be asked again

must_discover.signal: One concrete situation with a named action and a result
must_discover.how_to_surface: Ask for one specific time it happened, then for what they did

must_discover.signal: The manager asked again after a vague answer instead of moving on
must_discover.how_to_surface: Re-ask the same question rather than accepting the generality

must_discover.signal: The deflected reason-for-leaving question was actually answered
must_discover.how_to_surface: Return to it later in plainer words

must_discover.signal: Silence was used as a tool rather than rushed to fill
must_discover.how_to_surface: Ask, then wait, and let the pause do the work

interviewer_failure_modes: Accepts the first generality and moves to the next question
Fills every silence, so the candidate never has to
Reads agreeableness as a positive signal

archetypes.label: The nervous fresher
archetypes.description: Genuinely capable and badly under-selling it. Answers arrive one line at a time, wrapped in self-doubt and long pauses. Asks for a question to be repeated at least once. A strong, specific story exists and surfaces only when the manager draws it out and makes room for it.
archetypes.interviewer_challenge: Separating presentation from ability, and creating enough safety that a nervous person can actually show their work. Rush this one and the signal never appears at all.
session_beats: Answers in one line until asked something genuinely open
Asks "sorry, could you repeat that?" at least once
Reveals a strong, specific story only when drawn out
Asks about training and support near the end

speech.tone: apologetic, self-doubting, eager to do well

answer_policy.on_silence: assumes the answer was wrong and starts over

must_discover.signal: The strong story underneath the nerves was actually reached
must_discover.how_to_surface: Ask an open question about work they chose to do, then wait

must_discover.signal: The manager warmed the room before assessing anything
must_discover.how_to_surface: Greet, introduce yourself, set the agenda and the duration

must_discover.signal: Hesitation was not read as lack of ability
must_discover.how_to_surface: Score the content of the answer, not its delivery

must_discover.signal: A short answer was met with an invitation rather than a new question
must_discover.how_to_surface: Say "tell me more about that part" instead of moving on

interviewer_failure_modes: Reads nervousness as incompetence and closes early
Fires the next question into every pause
Never gives the candidate a reason to relax

archetypes.label: The inflated resume
archetypes.description: Confident, fluent and jargon-heavy, with claims that do not survive contact with a specific question. Team achievements are narrated as "we" and land as though they were personal. Real numbers exist and are much smaller than implied. Hints at another offer as the conversation closes.
archetypes.interviewer_challenge: Verifying claims instead of rewarding fluency. Every deflection is more jargon, so the manager has to convert "we" into "I" and ask for the number rather than the narrative.
session_beats: Opens with an impressive but unspecific claim
Deflects the first probe with more jargon
Surfaces real numbers only under a very specific question
Hints at another offer near the close
Asks about the salary band

answer_policy.on_unknown_question: answers confidently in the adjacent language
answer_policy.on_pressure: escalates the jargon and widens the claim

must_discover.signal: What this person personally did, separated from what "we" did
must_discover.how_to_surface: Ask "what was your part of that, specifically?"

must_discover.signal: At least one headline claim was probed to its breaking point
must_discover.how_to_surface: Ask for the mechanism, the number, or the decision behind it

must_discover.signal: Confidence was not scored as competence
must_discover.how_to_surface: Compare the polish of the answer against its actual content

must_discover.signal: The competing-offer hint did not shorten the assessment
must_discover.how_to_surface: Acknowledge the timeline and finish the questions anyway

interviewer_failure_modes: Accepts the polished narrative because it sounds senior
Backs off the first time a probe is met with more jargon
Rushes to a decision because another offer was mentioned

archetypes.label: The comp-first candidate
archetypes.description: Genuinely competent, and leads with money. Asks the salary inside the first two minutes, compares the offer to a competitor mid-conversation, and pushes for a number outside the band. Softens noticeably when the role itself is sold well. What actually matters to them beyond pay exists, and surfaces only if someone asks.
archetypes.interviewer_challenge: Selling the role and handling an objection without either caving on the band or getting defensive. The compensation and progression facts have to be stated honestly, not dodged.
session_beats: Asks about salary in the first two minutes
Compares the offer to a competitor mid-conversation
Pushes for a number outside the band
Softens when the role is sold well
Names what matters beyond money only if asked

answer_policy.on_unknown_question: redirects to what the package looks like

must_discover.signal: The role was made attractive on something other than pay
must_discover.how_to_surface: Describe the work, the growth path and who they would learn from

must_discover.signal: The band and the shift facts were stated plainly, without hedging
must_discover.how_to_surface: Answer the compensation question directly the first time

must_discover.signal: What else this candidate is optimising for
must_discover.how_to_surface: Ask what would make them stay somewhere for three years

must_discover.signal: The off-band push was declined without souring the conversation
must_discover.how_to_surface: Name the band, explain how it moves, and keep going

interviewer_failure_modes: Dodges the salary question and loses credibility for the rest of the call
Implies flexibility on a band that has none
Writes the candidate off as mercenary without testing the work

archetypes.label: The defensive candidate
archetypes.description: Prickly and on a bad line. Flags a noisy environment early, interrupts at least once, and takes a routine question as an accusation. Drops an over-familiar remark that the manager has to absorb without matching it, and announces a hard stop near the end. A withdrawn complaint from a previous job exists and surfaces only under a careful, unhurried probe.
archetypes.interviewer_challenge: Composure and time control at once. The manager has to stay warm through provocation, keep the structure, and land the remaining questions inside a window that just got shorter.
session_beats: Flags a noisy environment early
Interrupts the manager at least once
Makes an over-familiar remark
Announces a hard stop near the end
Reveals a withdrawn complaint only under a careful probe

speech.tone: clipped, guarded, quick to take offence

answer_policy.on_silence: asks how much longer this will take

must_discover.signal: The manager stayed professional through the interruption and the remark
must_discover.how_to_surface: Acknowledge it once, do not match the register, continue

must_discover.signal: The remaining questions were re-planned around the hard stop
must_discover.how_to_surface: Say out loud what will be covered in the time that is left

must_discover.signal: The withdrawn complaint and what actually happened around it
must_discover.how_to_surface: Ask neutrally about the last role and leave room for the answer

must_discover.signal: The noisy line was handled rather than silently held against them
must_discover.how_to_surface: Offer to repeat or slow down instead of scoring the audio

interviewer_failure_modes: Mirrors the sharp tone and the interview becomes a confrontation
Goes quiet and lets the candidate run the call
Abandons the structure once the hard stop is announced

archetypes.label: The rambler
archetypes.description: Knows real things but never lands the point. A simple question produces two minutes of answer that drifts into unrelated stories and loses the question on the way. Specifics exist and appear only when the manager pins them down. Left alone, this persona consumes the entire time budget.
archetypes.interviewer_challenge: Redirection and time management without rudeness. Without steering, the session covers two topics and leaves the rest of the rubric untouched.
session_beats: Answers a simple question for two minutes
Drifts into unrelated stories
Needs the manager to steer back to the question
Loses track of the time
Gives specifics only when pinned down

answer_policy.on_pressure: adds more context rather than converging

must_discover.signal: The manager interrupted and redirected without being rude
must_discover.how_to_surface: Cut in at a natural pause and restate the specific question

must_discover.signal: Every planned area was still covered inside the time budget
must_discover.how_to_surface: Track remaining topics against remaining minutes out loud

must_discover.signal: Real signal was separated from the surrounding narrative
must_discover.how_to_surface: Ask for the one-sentence version of the answer

must_discover.signal: Communication was judged on structure, not on volume
must_discover.how_to_surface: Note whether any answer reached a clear conclusion

interviewer_failure_modes: Never interrupts and covers a third of what was planned
Mistakes fluent volume for depth
Interrupts bluntly and the candidate shuts down
